rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, img_sx=2.5, img_sy=2.5, proj_sy=0.5, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-15, ONE-KNOB change vs the iter-12 CHAMPION base (SSIM 0.974822, PSNR 38.63 dB; proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=0.0005, proj_sx=1.0 default, proj_sy=2.0 default, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, img_sx=img_sy=2.5, n_iter=300). KNOB: projection-domain BF SPATIAL sigma proj_sy 2.0 -> 0.5 (TIGHTEN the DETECTOR-axis spatial extent of the sinogram BF), ISOLATED. proj_sy is THE ONE SPATIAL SIGMA NEVER ISOLATED on this run -- the genuinely-untried single-knob axis. iter-2 swapped proj_sx+proj_sy+proj_sr ALL AT ONCE off the WRONG loose base (img_sr=0.02, img_n_bf=1; confounded, HURT 0.9680, reverted); iter-14 isolated the SIBLING proj_sx (1.0->0.5 TIGHTEN) and it DROPPED to 0.973835. proj_sy has never been isolated at the established tight-RANGE peak regime (proj_sr=0.0005, img all tuned). EVERYTHING else identical to iter-12 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, img_sx=img_sy=2.5, seed=42; proj_sx/img_kernel/proj_kernel at Wagner-abdomen defaults). TRAJECTORY: iter-4 (img_n_bf 1->3) 0.9732 PEAK; iter-8 (proj_sr 0.02->0.0005 ISOLATED) 0.9747 NEW PEAK +0.0015; iter-9 (proj_sr->0.0001) FLAT; iter-10 (proj_n_bf 1->2) FLAT; iter-11 (img_sx 1.5->0.5 TIGHTEN) FLAT; iter-12 (img_sx/img_sy 1.5->2.5 WIDEN) 0.974822 CHAMPION (+0.0001); iter-13 (img_sx/img_sy 2.5->3.5) 0.974814 FLAT; iter-14 (proj_sx 1.0->0.5 TIGHTEN, isolated) 0.973835 DOWN -- proj-spatial TIGHTEN on the proj_sx axis is wrong-direction. FAILURE MODE at 0.9748: the 12-param bilateral is at its breast FBP-bounded representational ceiling; hr=0, PSNR ~38.63 pinned ~1 dB under the 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline. EXHAUSTED axes: img_n_bf, img_kernel (7->9 flat), img_sr (tight peak), proj_sr (0.0005 peak, 0.0001 flat), proj_n_bf (2 flat), img_sx/img_sy (full 0.5/1.5/2.5/3.5 sweep flat), n_iter, pretrain, seed, proj_sx (1.0->0.5 DOWN). The LAST genuinely-untried single-knob axis is proj_sy. WHY proj_sy NOW: it is the only spatial sigma never isolated; iter-14 already tested its sibling proj_sx and that axis was wrong-direction (tighten DOWN), so proj_sy is the final spatial-sigma component to characterize before the spatial-sigma family can be declared fully exhausted in BOTH domains. The Wagner-abdomen default proj_sy=2.0 is the LARGEST proj-spatial sigma (vs proj_sx=1.0); at the established tight proj_sr=0.0005 (edge-preserving in sinogram intensity) the proj_sr already gates cross-edge averaging, so the 2.0 detector-axis extent may over-average across the air/breast attenuation boundary in the sinogram; tightening proj_sy 2.0->0.5 restricts detector-axis sinogram averaging to the nearest same-tissue samples before FBP. HYPOTHESIS: tightening the projection-domain BF detector-axis spatial sigma proj_sy 2.0->0.5 at tight proj_sr either (a) lifts SSIM above the 0.974822 champion (if the 2.0 default was over-averaging the sinogram edge and proj_sy is a live lever the way proj_sr was), or (b) is FLAT/DOWN like its sibling proj_sx (iter-14, 0.973835). If FLAT-or-DOWN, the projection-SPATIAL axis is CONFIRMED exhausted across BOTH proj_sx AND proj_sy, completing the spatial-sigma family in both domains and SEALING the ~0.9748 12-param breast bilateral structural ceiling across RANGE (img_sr/proj_sr), DEPTH (img_n_bf/proj_n_bf), KERNEL (img_kernel), OPTIMIZATION (n_iter) and the FULL SPATIAL-sigma family (img_sx/img_sy + proj_sx/proj_sy) -- the BF inductive bias approaches but cannot beat a clean 128-view breast FBP (mirroring dd-bf-supervised 0.9502 on Mayo). WALL: BF spatial cost is independent of sigma VALUE (same proj_kernel=5 window, same unfold); step budget IDENTICAL to iter-12 (n_iter=300, val_n=16; warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800); iter-12 ran 497 s, far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged. ONE knob changed: proj_sy 2.0->0.5 (isolated).
